notes.title: May PlayX4 Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/a86b166bba197c6d9301fd8971f72a0e85bdf75d.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Super AI V.E.D.A announces a simulator system update to train you.

The V.E.D.A training program will be unveiled at PlayX4 2025, held at KINTEX from May 22nd to May 25th, 2025.

Triperl Games will directly supervise your Soulslike genre training on-site.

Through hands-on control, you can learn basic combat moves such as attacking, defending, and dodging, and experience battles with elite monsters that even beginners can easily challenge.

Don't miss this opportunity if you want to try the Soulslike genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/95040387e52f6423d3446f1688f738cf653ea23a.png[/img]

[Demo Information]
- Experience Time: About 15 minutes
- Demo Content: Tutorial Mission and Alces Boss Battle
- Booth Location: KINTEX 1 Hall 4, C03

P.S. We'll be waiting for all trainees at the exhibition hall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/02af01d4d44f2d0f81285d84540644029f4f2cd4.png[/img]

[h3]Discord Server Launch Announcement[/h3]
Triperl Games' official Discord server is now open!

You can now receive various news and updates about V.E.D.A in real-time through Discord.

- Real-time communication with the community
- Game updates and event news
- Direct feedback exchange with developers

Discord Server Invite Link: https://discord.gg/Dbwq73us

We look forward to your participation!

notes.title: BIC 2024, Gamescom 2024
notes.content:
[h2]From Tripearl Games,[/h2]

Hello Agents,
We hope you're staying cool during this hot summer!
V.E.D.A has some exciting news to share. In addition to participating in upcoming game shows, we have some special announcements for you.

[h2]#1 What's New?[/h2]
Over the past year, we’ve listened to your feedback and have worked closely with V.E.D.A to completely redesign the training simulator.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/0ca09dfa0149f894536738f7161b42e77615d634.png[/img]
[h3][b]Main Redesigns[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated characters to real-life proportions and improved graphics
[*]Enhanced and expanded Roguelite system
[*]New weapons, gears, and enemies
[/list]
Detailed info of the redesign will be shared through future posts.
We welcome your feedback and invite you to be part of the ongoing development process.
Mark your calendars and prepare to dive into V.E.D.A!

notes.title: Dev. Log #2
notes.content:
[h2]From Tripearl Games,[/h2]

Greetings Esteemed Agents.

Tripearl Games is fully committed to crafting the premier training simulator for V.E.D.A and agents worldwide. We are delighted to offer insights into our development processes.

In addition to sharing the visual aspects of our agents, we recognize the significance of designing their training environments. Through collaboration with V.E.D.A, Tripearl Games has iterated on various designs.

While we are unable to unveil every prototype per V.E.D.A's request, we can offer a glimpse into the initial designs we've created for immersive training environments.

[h3]Simulation[/h3]
[list]
[*]The simulator simulates facilities and indoor environments on the surface
[*]We implemented unique loading screens to portray the simulator aspects during training.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
[h2]From Tripearl Games,[/h2]

Greetings esteemed agents,
At Tripearl Games, we're at the forefront of innovating global agent training. Leveraging over 20 years of experience in creating immersive 3D action RPGs, our collaboration with V.E.D.A has enabled us to develop advanced training simulators, setting new standards in the industry.

We are delighted to offer you exclusive access to initial development footage and imagery, providing you with a glimpse into the evolution of this groundbreaking project. Your insights and feedback are invaluable to us as we strive for excellence in every aspect of our design.

[i]* click the GIF to enlarge[/i]

[h3]1. Initial Design[/h3]
[table noborder=1, table equalcells=1]
[tr]

[/tr]
[/table]
During the initial design phase with V.E.D.A, we aimed to use our open-world development expertise to create a post-apocalyptic reality where survival is critically challenged, ensuring a deeply immersive experience.

[h3]2. Progression[/h3]
[table noborder=1, table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/197250426af99677f6db940d99765ecd10ec1ed4.gif[/img][/th]

[/tr]
[/table]
After discussions with V.E.D.A, we recognized budget and time constraints, leading us to concentrate on enhancing the combat training experience. By undertaking a comprehensive redesign, we incorporated Soulslike combat elements, introduced UI improvements, and refined the combat mechanics to elevate the gameplay experience.

[h3]3. Current Build[/h3]
[table noborder=1, table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868139/9e4a30703d64f4c5a1bdf09e6a40037125ed6a4e.gif[/img][/th]

[/tr]
[/table]
Our redesign has elevated the simulator by deepening environmental detail and enriching combat dynamics, blending Soulslike mechanics with innovative features like Overclock and Roguelite elements for unparalleled immersion. This advancement has significantly strengthened our collaboration with V.E.D.A.

We aim for you to excel as an elite agent by mastering Soulslike combat through our advancing training simulator.

[code][h3][spoiler][b]Encrypted Message[/b]
Our collaboration with V.E.D.A is focused on enhancing the quality of the training simulator, while remaining mindful of potential anomalies. Rest assured, our development team is fully committed to delivering top-notch training and ensuring transparency and integrity across all aspects of the development process.[/spoiler][/h3][/code]

notes.title: V.E.D.A & Tripearl's Journey
notes.content:
[h2]From V.E.D.A,[/h2]

Esteemed Agents,
In anticipation of the forthcoming official training simulator, V.E.D.A extends its gratitude to Tripearl Games for their collaboration in sharing glimpses of our simulator's evolution. Reflect on your pre-training experiences within the simulator as we prepare for the next phase of our journey.

[h2]From Tripearl Games,[/h2]

Greetings,
Tripearl Games proudly recounts its participation alongside V.E.D.A in prominent gaming exhibitions spanning 2022 and 2023. We are delighted to offer insights into our collective experiences during the pre-training phase of the simulator.

[h3][b]1. Gyeonggi Game Audition 2022[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Audition Date: Sep. 7th, 2022
[*] Tripearl Games, in conjunction with V.E.D.A, unveiled the simulator prototype at the Gyeonggi Game Audition 2022, marking a pivotal moment in our public engagement.
[*] This debut garnered acclaim from prospective agents, with particular emphasis on the prototype's showcasing of the our first boss called Charcutier Alces encounter, culminating in our recognition with the 3rd place and Playstation’s Pick award.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome Agents!
notes.content:
[h2]From V.E.D.A,[/h2]

Hello Agents! V.E.D.A welcomes you to take part in its training simulator. V.E.D.A wishes Tripearl Games to give you a brief information of V.E.D.A.

[h2]From Tripearl Games,[/h2]

[h3]What is V.E.D.A?[/h3]

V.E.D.A is a super AI that aims to “train” you, agents, well. V.E.D.A generates a training simulator and for a optimal training experience, V.E.D.A will guide you along the way.
[code][spoiler][b]Encrypted Message[/b]
Be Advised: V.E.D.A did not share the purpose of the training.[/spoiler][/code]

[h3]What do Agents need to do?[/h3]

You, agents, are transmitted into a training simulator right after being awakened from cryosleep. Agents will not only train for battle, but also learn to navigate multiple areas that reflects the surface terrains.
[code][spoiler][b]Encrypted Message[/b]
V.E.D.A does not provide any information of your past memories[/spoiler][/code]

[h3]Who are Tripearl Games?[/h3]

Tripearl Games is a Korean indie game studio that utilizes Unreal Engine 5 to create V.E.D.A’s simulator and covey V.E.D.A’s messages to people outside of the simulator. We’ll do our best to fully develop the simulator for agents to train well and fair.
[code][spoiler][b]Encrypted Message[/b]
V.E.D.A will kindly guide you, but the simulator will not be easy.[/spoiler][/code]
